entities.title: zazz-format
entities.summary: The zazz-format crate, the library that defines the .zazz file: a strict ZIP subset, the zazz.json manifest, deterministic packing, the zazz.sig signature envelope and BLAKE3 script ids.
entities.purpose: Holds the format half of zazz scripts apart from the daemon that runs them, so the rules for what a .zazz may contain live in one small crate with three dependencies. The crate manifest (Cargo.toml, a member of the macos/rust workspace, each dependency commented with its reason) and the source in src/.
boundaries: A library only: no binary, nothing installed on its own; zazzled is its one dependent in the workspace.
Says what an archive, manifest and envelope are, not what is trusted or allowed: signature verification, certificate chains, grants and the sandbox are zazzled's (macos/rust/zazzled/src/zazz).
Does no I/O beyond reading a directory to pack; archives are read and written in memory.
